label: D1 fixation step late in the episode (trial >= 60) when the model value is low and the policy is not strongly committed
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), only in trials 60-99 of the episode (none before trial 50; the rate rises toward the end), and only when the value head is low (value < ~7.1; nothing above 7.5) and the D1 choice logit sits in a moderate range (about -1.5 to 8). This envelope covers ~97% of activation mass (all of the top two quartiles) but has very low precision (~4%): the feature is sparse even inside it. Within the envelope it is enriched when the upcoming choice is a switch (stay==0, 6x lift; ~13% precision, but only 38% of mass), after rare previous transitions, and after unrewarded trials, with no single clean trigger found. Only observed or model-internal variables are used (value/choice are the model outputs at that step). The firing condition inside the envelope is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over trial before (D1: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and last trial (D1: a1 S2 r, a1 S2 u, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, phase=D1 & ep_dec=7.
